objective:
Replace core-data's scaffold placeholder Room database with the real schema version 1 (entities, type converters, database class) and prove its integrity constraints with host-side tests. This task defines TABLE STRUCTURE only; DAO write/read operations beyond what tests need to insert fixture rows are the next task.

CONTEXT: core-data is an Android library (package root com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.data), Room 2.8.5 via KSP, exportSchema to tracked core-data/schemas. core-domain (already a dependency) provides public enums in com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain.model: ActivityState, ActivityResolution, ProcessingState, TimePrecision, VisibilityStatus, CanonicalActivityStatus, AliasSource, CorrectionSource, CaptureSource, InterpretationOperation, ValidationStatus, ConfidenceBand. Test tooling from the previous task: Robolectric (sdk=35), @RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class), org.junit.Test with kotlin.test assertions, helper inMemoryTestDatabase<T>() in core-data/src/test/.../core/data/TestDatabases.kt (currently forces PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON via a callback), driver-based MigrationTestHelper(instrumentation, file=getDatabasePath(name), driver=AndroidSQLiteDriver(), databaseClass=X::class) - the Instrumentation/Class constructor fails on Windows. IDs are text UUIDs (IdFactory in core.data.id); tests may use literal or DeterministicIdFactory IDs. Read docs/DATA_MODEL.md section 2 for the base column lists and docs/proposals/room-schema/TOOLING_NOTES.md for tooling details.

SCHEMA (all entities internal; suggested packages core.data.db / core.data.db.entity / core.data.db.converter, your call). Column names snake_case exactly as DATA_MODEL section 2. Timestamps INTEGER epoch millis. Text primary key `id` on every table.
1. raw_captures: id, source[CaptureSource], source_surface NULL, captured_at, raw_text, speech_confidence REAL NULL, speech_alternatives_json NULL, processing_state[ProcessingState], created_at, updated_at, PLUS captured_zone_id TEXT NOT NULL (IANA zone id). Indexes: captured_at; processing_state.
2. canonical_activities: id, display_name, normalized_name, status[CanonicalActivityStatus], created_at, updated_at, merged_into_activity_id NULL. Indexes: normalized_name (NON-unique); status; merged_into_activity_id.
3. activity_aliases: id, canonical_activity_id, alias_text, normalized_alias, source[AliasSource], confidence REAL NULL, created_at. UNIQUE index (canonical_activity_id, normalized_alias).
4. interpretations: id, raw_capture_id, created_at, interpreter_version, prompt_version, schema_version INTEGER, operation[InterpretationOperation], activity_resolution[ActivityResolution], matched_activity_id NULL, proposed_canonical_name NULL, activity_state[ActivityState] NULL, temporal_expression NULL, resolved_occurred_at NULL, time_precision[TimePrecision] NULL, model_confidence_band[ConfidenceBand] NULL, candidate_context_hash NULL, structured_result_json NULL, validation_status[ValidationStatus], validation_reason NULL. Indexes: raw_capture_id; matched_activity_id.
5. activity_occurrences: id, canonical_activity_id, raw_capture_id, effective_interpretation_id, captured_at, occurred_at, time_precision[TimePrecision], activity_state[ActivityState], visibility_status[VisibilityStatus], created_at, updated_at. Indexes: (canonical_activity_id ASC, occurred_at DESC); occurred_at DESC; raw_capture_id UNIQUE; effective_interpretation_id.
6. corrections: id, occurrence_id, created_at, source[CorrectionSource], reason NULL, previous_canonical_activity_id NULL, new_canonical_activity_id NULL, previous_occurred_at NULL, new_occurred_at NULL, previous_time_precision NULL, new_time_precision NULL, previous_activity_state NULL, new_activity_state NULL, previous_effective_interpretation_id NULL, new_effective_interpretation_id NULL. Indexes: occurrence_id; plus each FK child column below.
Nullability: NOT NULL unless marked NULL above.

FOREIGN KEYS (real SQLite FKs; onDelete and onUpdate NO_ACTION or RESTRICT only; NO CASCADE and NO SET_NULL/SET_DEFAULT anywhere): activity_aliases.canonical_activity_id -> canonical_activities.id; interpretations.raw_capture_id -> raw_captures.id; interpretations.matched_activity_id -> canonical_activities.id; activity_occurrences.canonical_activity_id -> canonical_activities.id; activity_occurrences.raw_capture_id -> raw_captures.id; activity_occurrences.effective_interpretation_id -> interpretations.id; corrections.occurrence_id -> activity_occurrences.id; corrections.previous_canonical_activity_id and new_canonical_activity_id -> canonical_activities.id; corrections.previous_effective_interpretation_id and new_effective_interpretation_id -> interpretations.id; canonical_activities.merged_into_activity_id -> canonical_activities.id. Every FK child column must be covered by an index (as leading column) so Room emits no FK-index warnings.

ENUM STORAGE: explicit @TypeConverters storing the enum constant name; reading an unknown name must throw (IllegalArgumentException or similar, message naming the enum), never map to a default.

DATABASE: ActivityLedgerDatabase (internal abstract, extends RoomDatabase), version = 1, exportSchema = true, all six entities, converters registered. May expose minimal internal DAOs whose only purpose now is inserting fixture rows in tests (plain @Insert per entity) - the next task will reshape DAOs and restrict write operations, so do not build query/update APIs here. No fallbackToDestructiveMigration anywhere. No production database builder/factory (a later task).

PLACEHOLDER REMOVAL: delete ScaffoldPlaceholderEntity.kt, ScaffoldPlaceholderDao.kt, ScaffoldPlaceholderDatabase.kt, the directory core-data/schemas/com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.data.ScaffoldPlaceholderDatabase, and PlaceholderRoomToolingTest.kt. Keep the tooling coverage by re-targeting it at ActivityLedgerDatabase: an in-memory open round-trip, and a driver-based MigrationTestHelper createDatabase(1) + runMigrationsAndValidate(1) from the new exported 1.json.

FOREIGN-KEY ENFORCEMENT MUST BE REAL: the production database will not have the test callback. Remove the forced PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON callback from inMemoryTestDatabase (keep the helper otherwise), and prove with a test that ActivityLedgerDatabase built by plain Room has PRAGMA foreign_keys = 1 and rejects a dangling reference. If Room does not enable it on its own, STOP and report scope_change_requested with evidence rather than re-adding a test-only callback.
non_goals: No query/read DAO methods, no update/delete methods, no transactional operations (acceptInterpretation, applyCorrection) - next task.
No production database builder/factory, no migrations list, no migration harness beyond the v1 createDatabase/validate proof - later task.
No SQLite triggers, no views, no FTS tables.
No changes to core-domain, other modules, core-data/build.gradle.kts, gradle/libs.versions.toml, or any doc (including TOOLING_NOTES.md and DATA_MODEL.md).
No logging of row contents; no ML Kit; no fallbackToDestructiveMigration.
Do not disable, @Ignore or weaken tests; do not suppress Room/KSP warnings.
acceptance_criteria: core-data/schemas/<ActivityLedgerDatabase FQCN>/1.json exists (generated by KSP, not hand-written) and shows exactly the six tables with the listed columns, types and NOT NULL/NULL, including raw_captures.captured_zone_id NOT NULL, and every listed foreign key and index (unique where stated, DESC orders where stated). It contains no CASCADE, SET NULL or SET DEFAULT.

Integrity tests pass on the real database: deleting a raw capture referenced by an interpretation fails; deleting a raw capture referenced by an occurrence fails; deleting an interpretation referenced by an occurrence fails; deleting a canonical activity referenced by an occurrence fails; inserting an occurrence whose canonical_activity_id does not exist fails; inserting a second occurrence for the same raw_capture_id fails; inserting a duplicate (canonical_activity_id, normalized_alias) alias fails while the same normalized_alias under a different activity succeeds; two canonical activities with the same normalized_name can both be inserted.
A test shows ActivityLedgerDatabase opened via Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder with no extra callback has PRAGMA foreign_keys = 1, and inMemoryTestDatabase no longer forces the pragma.

Converter tests: every constant of every enum round-trips through its converter; an unknown stored name throws. A row-level test inserts and reads back a row with a non-null value in every enum column (raw SQL select is fine) and the stored text equals the constant name.
Tooling coverage retained against ActivityLedgerDatabase: in-memory round-trip and driver-based MigrationTestHelper createDatabase(1) then runMigrationsAndValidate(1) both pass.

No placeholder remains: `grep -ri placeholder core-data/src core-data/schemas` finds nothing; the old schema directory is gone. KSP/compile output shows no Room warnings (quote the relevant build output). No fallbackToDestructiveMigration in core-data.
`./gradlew :core-data:test --rerun-tasks` passes with JUnit XML counts reported per test class, and `./gradlew test` passes for all modules.
